prompt.en: Predict: if five classmates each time how long an ice cube takes to melt on the same kind of plate, will they all get exactly the same time? Why or why not?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar paanch classmates alag-alag time karein ki ek ice cube ek jaisi plate pe kitni der mein pighalta hai, kya sabka time bilkul same aayega? Kyon ya kyon nahi?

challenges.hint: Point to human reaction time with a stopwatch

prompt.en: Three trials of how long an ice cube takes to melt gave 12 minutes, 14 minutes and 13 minutes. What is the average time?
prompt.hi: Ice cube pighalne ke teen trials mein 12 minute, 14 minute aur 13 minute aaye. Average time kitna hai?

challenges.hint: Point to adding all three first

prompt.en: A plant's height is measured once a week: week 1: 2 cm, week 2: 4 cm, week 3: 6 cm, week 4: 8 cm. Predict its height at week 5 if the pattern continues, and say which graph shows this best.
prompt.hi: Ek paudhe ki lambai har hafte naapi: hafta 1: 2 cm, hafta 2: 4 cm, hafta 3: 6 cm, hafta 4: 8 cm. Agar pattern chalta rahe toh hafta 5 mein kitni hogi, aur kaunsa graph sabse achha dikhayega?

challenges.hint: Point to time on the x-axis

prompt.en: Data from one city shows that in weeks when more umbrellas are sold, more people catch colds. Does buying umbrellas cause colds?
prompt.hi: Ek shehar ka data dikhata hai ki jin hafton mein zyada chhatriyaan bikti hain, us waqt zyada log sardi-zukaam se beemar hote hain. Kya chhatri khareedne se zukaam hota hai?

challenges.hint: Point to the season

prompt.en: From last time: if two things go up together, does that prove one causes the other?
prompt.hi: Pichhli baar se: agar do cheezein saath-saath badhti hain, kya isse prove hota hai ki ek doosre ka kaaran hai?

challenges.hint: Point to the hidden third factor

prompt.en: Predict before the microscope view: a thin onion peel is placed under a microscope in the school lab. Will we see cells? What shape might they be?
prompt.hi: Microscope mein dekhne se pehle guess karo: school lab mein pyaaz ki patli jhilli microscope ke neeche rakhi hai. Kya cells dikhengi? Kis shape ki ho sakti hain?

challenges.hint: Point to bricks in a wall as a picture

prompt.en: Predict: a desert cooler has had water standing in it for two weeks during the monsoon. The water looks clean. Is it a mosquito risk?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: monsoon mein ek desert cooler mein do hafte se paani khada hai. Paani saaf dikhta hai. Kya isse machchharon ka khatra hai?

challenges.hint: Point to the kind of water Aedes prefers

prompt.en: Predict: if someone with a viral cold takes an antibiotic, will the cold go away faster?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar viral zukaam wala koi antibiotic le, kya zukaam jaldi theek hoga?

challenges.hint: Point to what antibiotics target

prompt.en: Predict: two identical bulbs are joined one after the other in a loop with one cell. Will the second bulb be dimmer because the first one 'used up' some current?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: ek cell ke saath do ek jaise bulb ek ke baad ek jode. Kya doosra bulb kam roshni dega kyunki pehle ne kuch current 'kharch' kar diya?

challenges.hint: Point to one single path for the charges

prompt.en: You have potatoes instead of lemons. Could they work as cells? What else would you need?
prompt.hi: Nimbu ki jagah tumhare paas aaloo hain. Kya woh cell ki tarah kaam kar sakte hain? Aur kya chahiye?

challenges.hint: Point to the juice inside a potato

prompt.en: Predict: you throw a ball straight up. At the very top, when it stops for a moment, is gravity still acting on it?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: gend seedhi upar phenkte ho. Sabse oonchi jagah, jab woh ek pal rukti hai, kya gravity tab bhi lag rahi hai?

challenges.hint: Point to what makes it come back

prompt.en: A box weighing 200 N rests on a face of area 0.5 m². What pressure does it exert on the floor?
prompt.hi: 200 N weight ka dabba 0.5 m² area wale hisse pe rakha hai. Woh farsh pe kitna pressure daalta hai?

challenges.hint: Point to dividing force by area

prompt.en: The same 200 N box is turned onto a smaller face of area 0.1 m². What is the pressure now, and what does this show?
prompt.hi: Wahi 200 N ka dabba 0.1 m² wale chhote hisse pe palat diya. Ab pressure kitna hai, aur isse kya pata chalta hai?

challenges.hint: Point to the smaller area

prompt.en: Predict: sodium is a soft metal that reacts violently with water, and chlorine is a poisonous gas. Will the compound they form, common salt, be dangerous to eat in small amounts?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: sodium ek naram dhaatu hai jo paani se zor se react karti hai, aur chlorine zehreeli gas hai. Dono se bana compound, namak, kya thodi maatra mein khaana khatarnaak hoga?

challenges.hint: Point to new properties in a compound

prompt.en: Predict: you can change the amount of sugar in nimbu paani as you like. Can you make the compound water with 'a bit more oxygen' in it? Why or why not?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: nimbu paani mein cheeni apni marzi se kam-zyada kar sakte ho. Kya compound paani mein 'thodi zyada oxygen' daal kar bana sakte ho? Kyon ya kyon nahi?

challenges.hint: Point to mixtures allowing any amount

prompt.en: Predict: can gold be broken down into simpler substances by cutting, heating or chemical reactions?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: kya sone ko kaatne, garam karne ya chemical reaction se aur saral substances mein toda ja sakta hai?

challenges.hint: Point to smaller pieces still being gold

prompt.en: Predict: if you look closely at a polished granite kitchen counter with a hand lens, will it look the same everywhere? What will you see?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: granite ke chikne kitchen counter ko magnifying glass se dhyaan se dekho toh kya har jagah ek jaisa dikhega? Kya dikhega?

challenges.hint: Point to different shapes and colours

prompt.en: Predict: you add one spoon of salt at a time to half a cup of water and stir each time. Will every spoon dissolve, however many you add?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: aadhe cup paani mein ek-ek chammach namak daal ke har baar hilao. Kya har chammach ghul jaayega, chahe kitne bhi daal do?

challenges.hint: Point to salt sitting at the bottom

prompt.en: Predict: two identical cups of water at the same temperature. You add salt to one and sugar to the other, a spoon at a time. Will both stop dissolving after the same number of spoons?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: ek jaise do cup paani, ek hi temperature. Ek mein namak aur doosre mein cheeni, ek-ek chammach daalo. Kya dono same chammach ke baad ghulna band karenge?

challenges.hint: Point to solubility being a property of each substance

prompt.en: A block has a mass of 60 g and a volume of 20 cm³. What is its density?
prompt.hi: Ek block ka mass 60 g aur volume 20 cm³ hai. Iski density kitni hai?

challenges.hint: Point to mass ÷ volume

prompt.en: From last time: what is the density of water in g/cm³?
prompt.hi: Pichhli baar se: paani ki density g/cm³ mein kitni hai?

prompt.en: A ray strikes a plane mirror with an angle of incidence of 40°. What is the angle of reflection?
prompt.hi: Ek kiran plane mirror par 40° ke angle of incidence se padti hai. Angle of reflection kitna hoga?

challenges.hint: Point to incidence = reflection

prompt.en: Predict: a ray makes 25° with the mirror surface. What angle will the reflected ray make with the normal?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: ek kiran mirror ki sataha se 25° banaati hai. Reflected kiran normal se kitna kona banayegi?

challenges.hint: Point to the normal at 90° to the mirror

prompt.en: Predict: just after sunset you see a thin crescent moon. In which direction of the sky will it be: east or west?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: suraj doobne ke turant baad tumhe patla chaand dikhta hai. Woh aasmaan mein kis disha mein hoga: purab ya paschim?

challenges.hint: Point to a crescent being near the Sun in the sky

prompt.en: An astronaut standing on the Moon looks at Earth on the night we have a full moon. Would Earth look fully lit, half lit or almost dark?
prompt.hi: Jis raat humein poora chaand dikhta hai, us raat Chaand par khada astronaut Prithvi ko dekhta hai. Prithvi poori roshan, aadhi roshan ya lagbhag andheri dikhegi?

challenges.hint: Point to which side of Earth faces the Moon

prompt.en: Predict: a calendar uses only 12 lunar months each year and never adds an extra month. After about 16 years, would a festival that started in summer still be in summer?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: ek calendar har saal sirf 12 chandra maah rakhta hai aur kabhi extra mahina nahi jodta. Lagbhag 16 saal baad, jo tyohaar garmi mein shuru hua tha, kya woh abhi bhi garmi mein hoga?

challenges.hint: Point to 11 × 16

prompt.en: Predict: is the year 2100 a leap year? Use the full Gregorian rule.
prompt.hi: Guess karo: kya 2100 leap year hoga? Gregorian ka poora niyam lagao.

challenges.hint: Point to dividing by 400

prompt.en: A satellite team plans a 4-year mission starting on 1 March 2027. How many days long is the mission, counting 1 March 2027 to 28 February 2031 inclusive?
prompt.hi: Ek satellite team 1 March 2027 se 4 saal ka mission plan karti hai. 1 March 2027 se 28 February 2031 tak, dono din milaake, mission kitne din ka hai?

challenges.hint: Point to 29 February 2028
